items.briefing:
ASIC is warning Australians that scammers are increasingly using AI to build convincing fake investment platforms, including deepfake videos of trusted figures to lure victims. Separately, a China-linked hacker group has been observed using AI tools in attacks targeting the Asia-Pacific region, which includes Australian organisations. These two threats highlight how AI is rapidly being adopted by malicious actors to make attacks and scams harder to detect.

OpenAI has also launched a teen-specific version of ChatGPT in Australia with added safety features — worth noting if you have young people using the platform at home or through your organisation.

**Tip:** If you see an investment opportunity promoted by a celebrity or financial expert online, verify it directly through ASIC's website before engaging.

featured.title: Keeper launches Microsoft Power Platform secrets connector
featured.summary: Organisations using Microsoft automation can now keep credentials out of scripts, reducing the risk of exposed secrets in cloud workflows.
